reason: r2 approved for distribution: lets the local hunter's target-camera tap window run out every frame, so the game raises its target request every frame and the camera stays on the targeted monster.
runtime_test: r2 accepted on Eden and MHGURecomp 0.14.3: "ok, work for both eden and recomp" and "its not spazzing at all". MHGURecomp logged "r2 loaded" and "expiring the local hunter's target window"; installed NRO matches on both.
